The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Atebrioz, a once-daily oral treatment from Mirum Pharmaceuticals and Incyte for adults and adolescents ages 12 and older with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva, or FOP, an ultra-rare genetic disease.

The drug is approved to reduce the volume of total new heterotopic ossification, the abnormal formation of bone in muscles, tendons, ligaments and other soft tissues that can progressively restrict movement in people with FOP.
